subject: Orion Conductor: workshop timeblocks, travel lanes & onsite logistics
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@orionconductor.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shenoy <priya.shenoy@orionconductor.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planning: onsite workshop week of May 17 - initial ask

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We'd like to lock in an in-person workshop in SF the week of May 17 (flexible +/- a week) to run architecture, SLAs, and deployment runbooks with our infra and security leads. High-level asks:

- 2 full days of workshops (day 1: architecture/throughput; day 2: security/compliance + rollout plan)
- Up to 8 Orion attendees (inc. 2 execs arriving late)
- AV: projector + laptop HDMI + two remote conference rooms (EU/APAC dial-in)
- Badge/vendor access for Redwood staff, and parking instructions for two cars

Can you propose preferred date blocks and a travel/fallback lane if any team members need to join virtually? Also please share a short draft agenda and attendee headcount we should publish internally.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Director of Infrastructure
Orion Conductor

[signature]
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@orionconductor.com>
Cc: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning: onsite workshop week of May 17 - initial ask

Hi Alex —

Thanks, this is helpful. Proposed approach:

1) Preferred onsite window: May 18-19 (Tuesday/Wednesday). Alternate: May 25-26.
2) We recommend scheduling core presentation blocks 09:30–12:30 and 14:00–16:30 local time to preserve overlap with EU late mornings (11:30–14:30 BST) and APAC early morning async.
3) Redwood onsite team: myself (lead), Maya (solutions architect), Ben (on-call ops) — we can cover both days.

I've attached a short draft agenda (Orion_Workshop_Draft_Agenda_v2.pdf) and a quick checklist for AV + badge requests. Two quick clarifying Qs:
- Final headcount for executive dinner on Tue night?
- Which VPC/region will you want test traffic routed to during the throughput run (us-west-2 or us-east-1)?

I'll loop in travel lanes and calendar invites once we confirm dates.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: onsite workshop week of May 17 - initial ask

On Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 08:03 AM PDT priyom_das@redwood.com wrote:
> I've attached a short draft agenda...

Adding a few ops notes from my side:
- AV: recommend we bring a second USB-C dongle, CAT6 patch lead, and a spare lapel mic. Venue-provided HDMI adapters are notoriously inconsistent.
- Network: request for a dedicated VLAN for test traffic with a temporary public egress IP; can you open a support ticket with your networking team so we can provision?
- Exec travel: if both execs arrive the evening before (Mon 17), we can schedule a short 30-min prep for them at 5pm Mon. Need headcount for dinner — recommend 6 (execs + 2 Redwood leads + 1 technical PM).

I'll draft a travel_manifest.xlsx with flights and hotel blocks once we have names — will share ETA by EOD Fri.

Cheers,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@orionconductor.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Calendar holds + travel manifest (provisional)

Hi all —

Per the proposed windows, I've created provisional calendar holds and a lightweight travel manifest (attached). Please treat these as tentative until we confirm exact attendee names.

- Calendar: May 18 09:30-17:00 Redwood x Orion Workshop (tentative) — invite includes two virtual rooms (EU dial-in + APAC Zoom). See gcal invite attached (gcal_invite.ics).
- Travel manifest attached: travel_manifest.xlsx includes sample arrival times and a column for badge name/party.

Attachments: travel_manifest.xlsx, gcal_invite.ics

If Orion can confirm the guest list and whether the execs will attend the prep slot Monday 17 at 17:00, I'll convert holds to confirmed events and request visitor badges with building security.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

Redwood Inference

Thanks team — this looks good. Final confirmations from Orion:

- Confirming May 18-19 onsite (we'll take preferred window).
- Execs (2) will arrive evening Mon 17 and will join the 17:00 prep slot.
- Headcount: 8 Orion attendees total; exec dinner on Mon night will be 6 people.
- VPC target for throughput testing: us-west-2.

Action items for Redwood: please confirm vendor badge process and send visitor badge request to building security (we will provide full names once Redwood raises the request). Also confirm if any parking passes are needed and whether Redwood staff require contractor badges.

I'll forward flight details by next Tue. Looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
